messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the demonstrated action in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the demonstration in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands on a paved road, then turns around to face away from the camera, and finally turns back to face the side.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from a side angle, capturing the person from head to toe.","clothing":"A sleeveless tank top with a pink, yellow, and white pattern, paired with pink shorts and pink sneakers.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky, swept-up hair.","identity":"A slim, dark-skinned person with a short, spiky white hairstyle, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"An outdoor paved road with a metal guardrail, rocks, and green foliage in the background under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original arm-raising motion was replaced with a standing sequence in which the person turns away, crosses their arms, brings a hand toward the chin in a pensive gesture, and then turns back to a side profile. The same person, clothing, outdoor road scene, lighting, and static side framing were retained.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose following the motion reference, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the exact timing and subtle body mechanics of the reference pose were fully matched.
unexpected_changes: The person's body orientation changes more than in the reference, including turning away from the camera and back.
